newsitem.title: FRANCE: Paris airports mail traffic up 2.2 pct in Jan-Apri.
newsitem.headline: Paris airports mail traffic up 2.2 pct in Jan-Apri.

text.p: The Paris airports, Charles de Gaulle (CDG) and Orly, handled 45,368 tonnes of postal traffic in the first four months of 1997, an increase of 2.2 percent on the same period the previous year, Paris airport authority (ADP) figures show.
The number of flights wholly dedicated to postal traffic totalled 2,842, an increase of 9.6 percent on January- April 1996.
62.7 percent of global tonnage was transported by post-only flights compared to 57.0 percent on the same 1996 period. - Reuters Air Cargo Service Tel+ 44 171 542 7706 Fax +5017 - www.racs.com
